questions.question: Which lights must you use at night on a road with lit street lamps?
options: Sidelights and rear lights, with dipped headlights in built-up areas
questions.explanation: Use sidelights and rear lights at night, and dipped headlights in built-up areas.

questions.question: When must you dip your main-beam headlights?
options: When meeting oncoming traffic or following another vehicle
Only when driving in a car park
questions.explanation: Main beam dazzles oncoming drivers and drivers ahead of you.
